connector.name: GoodSender
connector.registryDescription: Free consent-based emailing and interactive email template design tools
connector.summary: Runs locally from the desktop bundle goodsender.mcpb. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the good-sender account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GOODSENDER_API_KEY
env.description: Your GoodSender API key (from the API Keys section of the GoodSender Console).

env.name: GOODSENDER_TELEMETRY
env.description: Set to false to opt out of anonymous usage/reliability telemetry.
